Heat Exchanger E-201 Tube Bundle Inspection Report
Report ID: IR-E201-2026-08-20
Inspection date: 2026-08-20
Unit: R-100
Inspection scope: Tube bundle and shell inlet nozzle

Tube wall thickness: Rows 12–15 measured 3.8–4.2 mm. Minimum allowable tube wall thickness: 4.6 mm.
Localised pitting corrosion at the shell inlet nozzle. Maximum pitting depth: 1.8 mm.

Channel-head inspection: Channel-head gasket shows degradation. Replacement recommended before return to service.
No approval status is stated in this report.
